executeWith: tools/mars-fidelity/patch.mjs --base <same world URL> --receipt <same absolute receipt path> --rollback --apply
guards: Forward mesh bindings, all retained descendant poses/state and expected accepted revisions still match.
Latest non-engine authored edit is exactly receipt.appliedSeq in its unique receipt.batch.group.
The unique group has exactly one accepted, un-undone patch edit.
Release owner maintains a quiet authoring/active-use window for the final guard-to-undo interval.
verify: Exactly [receipt.appliedSeq] is reverted; all original targeted static IDs, descendant bindings/poses and previous sky/weather return.
retained: All accepted world and Soul history remains. Unused world-local definitions may remain.
warning: The public undo API has no atomic compare-and-swap for the authored head; the client preflight does not replace the release-owner quiet window.
